definition: to give something and receive something back
description: At a money-changer's booth in a busy covered bazaar, a moustached man in a grey shirt and dark waistcoat holds out a thick bundle of banknotes in both hands over a glass case. He counts through a stack of purple notes, then spreads dozens of notes into a wide fan across the counter, laying different currencies side by side. A young woman in an orange beanie watches with her mouth open in amazement, and at the end he passes a handful of notes over to a hand reaching in from the camera side.

en.question: What is the woman staring at?

de.answer: Sie starrt einen Fächer aus Geldscheinen an.
de.question: Was starrt die Frau an?

es.answer: Está mirando fijamente un abanico de billetes.
phrases: dar un grito ahogado de asombro
es.question: ¿Qué está mirando fijamente la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle fixe un éventail de billets.
fr.question: Que fixe la femme ?
